newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits new low as Iraq deal gets U.N. nod.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits new low as Iraq deal gets U.N. nod.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures hit a new low shortly after the NYMEX open as the United Nations reported that Secretary-general Boutros Boutros-Ghali had approved the startup of Iraqi oil sales under the oil-for-food deal.
Jan Brent was trading 47 cents lower at $24.07 a barrel at 1455 GMT, having just touched a session low of $23.95.
But some brokers were more focused on the movement of NYMEX futures than news from the U.N.
"It's hard to say that the (U.N. news) is really triggering it. I'd look at weakness on gasoline," a broker said.
